versions.changelog:
Initial release of anjuke-scraper skill

- Implements a complete pipeline for Anjuke rental listing scraping, geolocation, distance calculation, and Excel report generation.
- Supports batch collection and structured comparison of rental data near specific locations.
- Integrates anti-bot measures for efficient, verification-free data gathering.
- Includes city/keyword/configuration instructions for flexible reuse.
- Validated on Chongqing region; outputs well-structured data and Excel sheets for property comparison.
